items.text: Ezr 5:8
Esi 1:1

Anzi angu ndeniri yi ovu ’di’i, engazu ’ba mira jile ati’baru ’diyi ma eselia, Nebukadineza opi Babu­loniarini ndra jile ati’baru angu Babuloni ma alia ’diyi; yi atri dri vile Yerusalemua azini Yudaa, ’ba dria alu alu aku yini vusi.
Yi emu Zerubabeli pi be, Yesua pie, Nehe­mia pie, Seraya pie, Relaya pie, Moridekai pie, Bilisani pie, Misipari pie, Bigivai pie, Rehumi pie, Baana pie.
Kalafe ’ba Israeliniri eri ’di’i:
Anzi Parosini, alifu iri drini turu alu drini kali aziri drini iri.
Anzi Sefatiani, turu na kali aziri drini iri.
Neh 6:18
Anzi Arani, turu aziri kali aziri drini towi.
Anzi Pahati-moabuni, engapi anzi Yesuani azini anzi Yoabuni ma eselia ’diyi, alifu iri turu aro drini mudri drini iri.
Anzi Elamuni, alifu alu turu iri drini kali towi drini su.
Anzi Zatuni, turu oromi drini kali su drini towi.
Anzi Zakaini, turu aziri drini kali azia.
Anzi Banini, turu azia kali su drini iri.
Anzi Bebaini, turu azia kali iri drini na,
Anzi Azigadini, alifu alu turu iri drini kali iri drini iri.
Ezr 7:18
Anzi Adonikamuni, turu azia drini kali azia drini azia.
Anzi Bigivaini, alifu iri drini kali towi drini azia.
Anzi Adinini, turu su kali towi drini su.
Anzi Ateri, Hezekia vilerini, kali oromi drini aro.
Anzi Bezaini, turu nakaliiridrinina.
Anzi Yorani, turu alu mudri drini iri.
Anzi Hasumuni, turu iri kali iri drini na.
Yos 9:17
Anzi Gibarini, kali oromi drini towi.
Mat 2:6
Rut 1:19
Anzi Betelehemuni, turu alu kali iri drini na.
’Ba Neto­fani, kali towi drini azia,
’Ba Anatotini, turu alu drini kali iri drini aro.
Anzi Azimavetini, kali su drini iri.
Anzi Kiriatarimuni, Kefira pie, azini Beroti pie ’diyi, turu aziri kali su drini na.
Anzi Rema pini Geba be ’diyi, turu azia kali iri drini alu.
’Ba Mikimasini, turu alu kali iri drini iri.
Ba Beteli pini Ai be ’diyi, turu iri kali iri drini na.
Anzi Neboni, kali towi drini iri.
Magibisini, turu alu kali towi drini azia.
Ezr 2:7
Anzi Elamu andiniri vile ’diyi, alifu alu turu iri kali towi drini su.
Anzi Hari­muni, turu na drini kali iri.
Anzi Lodi pini, Hadidi pie, azini Ono pie ’diyi, turu aziri kali iri drini towi.
Azi 34:3
Anzi Yerikoni, turu na kali su drini towi.
Anzi Senaani, alifu na turu azia drini kali na.
Atalau edeta edepi ’diyi: anzi Yedayani, ori’ba Yesuani ma alia ’diyi, turu oromi kali aziri drini na.
Anzi Imerini, alifu alu kali towi drini iri.
Anzi Pasihurini, alifu a1u drini turu iri kali su drini aziri.
Anzi Harimuni, alifu alu drini mudri drini aziri.
Ezr 3:9
’Ba Levini ’diyi: anzi nde Yesua pini Kadimieli be, engapi anzi Hodaviani ma eselia ’diyi, yi kali aziri drini su.
’Ba ongo ngopi ’diyi: anzi Asafuni, turu alu kali iri drini aro.
Anzi ’ba kalitile agei tepi ’diyini: anzi Salumuni pie, anzi Aterini pie, anzi Talimonani pie, anzi Akubuni pie, anzi Hatitani pie, anzi Sobaini pie, kalafe yini dria turu alu kali na drini oromi.
1 Sur 9:2
’Ba Netini ’diyi: anzi Zihani pie, anzi Hasufani pie, anzi Tabao­tini pie,
anzi Kerosini pie, anzi Siahani pie, anzi Padonini pie,
anzi Lebanani pie, anzi Hagabani pie, anzi Akubuni pie,
anzi Hagabuni pie, anzi Samulaini pie, anzi Hananini pie,
anzi Gidelini pie, anzi Gaharini pie, anzi Reayani pie,
anzi Rezi­nini pie, anzi Nekodani pie, anzi Gazamuni pie,
anzi Uzani pie, anzi Paseani pie, anzi Besaini pie,
anzi Asinani pie, anzi Meunimuni pie, anzi Nefisimuni pie,
anzi Bakibukini pie, anzi Haku­fani pie, anzi Harihurini pie,
anzi Bazilutini pie, anzi Mehidani pie, anzi Harisani pie,
anzi Barikosini pie, anzi Siserani pie, anzi Temani pie,
anzi Neziani pie, anzi Hatifani pie.
Anzi ati’ba Sulemani vile ’diyini: anzi Sotaini pie, anzi Hasoferetini pie, anzi Perudani,
anzi Yaalani pie, anzi Darikonini pie, anzi Gidelini pie,
anzi Sefatiani pie, anzi Hatilini pie, anzi Pokereti-hazebaimuni pie, anzi Ami­ni pie.
Yos 9:21
1 Sur 9:2
Ezr 7:7
’Ba Netini dria, anzi ati’ba Sulemanini ’diyini be, yi ovu turu na kali oromi drini iri.
’Ba ndra mupi engapi Teli­melaa, Teli-harisaa, Kerubia, Ada­nia, azini Imeria yi ’diyi; te yi econi yi atapi ma suru ece ku, kani ori yini, nizu kani yi ovu ’ba Israelini yani:
anzi Delayani pie, anzi Tobiani pie, anzi Nekodani pie, turu azia kali towi drini iri.
1 Opi 2:7

’Ba ’dini ’diyi atalau edeta edepi ’diyi ma anzi ma eselia, yi ’diyi: anzi Habayani pie, anzi Hakozini pie, anzi Barizilaini (oku jepi Barizilai ’ba Gileadiari ma ezopi ma eselia, ovupi omvezaru yi ma rusiri).
Kal 3:10

’Ba ’diyi nda yi ma ru buku ru sizuri ma alia, ’ba ovupi lazaru a’bi vusi a’bi vusi ’diyi ma eselia, te yi isuni ku; e’yo ’disi la yi ekile ’ba ondi be ’diyile, oga azi atalau edeta edepiriniri yi drisi;
Neh 8:9
Lev 22:2
azini opi ambo ’ba dri cepiri ’yo yi tia, yi ma nya afa alatararu nga ku, kpere atalau alu edeta edepirini pa soria Urimu pi be Tumimu be ku.
’Ba dria yi okupi tualu ’diyi ma kalafe ovu ndra alifu kali su drini iri drini turu na drini kali azia,
azini drinia ati’ba yini agupiru ’diyi, okuru ’diyi pie, yi ovu alifu aziri turu na drini kali na drini aziri; azini ’ba yini ongo ngopi ’diyi turu iri, oku piyi agupi be.
Akanya amboru yini ma kalafe ndra turu aziri drini kali na drini azia, akanya farasiru ’diyi turu iri kali su drini towi,
ngamia yini turu su kali na drini towi, akanya esele were yini ’diyi alifu azia turu aziri drini kali iri.
Efu 25:2
’Ba ’wara atapi yini ma suru dri cepi ma azi ’diyi, yini ecaria jo Yehovani Yerusalemuaria, yi fe afa feza asi driasi jo Munguni engazu uru i ma paria;

yi fe ekile yini ecolerile pari silingi azi nde ngazuri ma ta mbazuria, silingi meleru opi Darioni edele ’diyi alifu kali azia drini alu, azini o’biza dahabuni alifu towi, azini bongo atalau edeta edepirini turu alu.

’Dini atalau edeta edepi ’diyi pi ’ba Levini pie, ’ba azini ’ba ma eselia ’diyi pie, ’ba ongo ngopi ’diyi pie, ’ba jotile agei tepi ’diyi pie, ’ba Netini pie, ovu di aku amboru yinia, azini ’ba Israelini ’diyi dria ovu aku amboru yinia indio
